```{r}
schools <- read_rds(nested_here("data", "cps_schools_analytic.rds"))

schools |> 
  summarise(
    across(c(matches("count"), ~ sum(.x) / sum(student_count))),
    .by = c("school_id", "data_schoolyear")
    ) |> 
  arrange(school_id, data_schoolyear) |> 
  slice(1, .by = school_id) |> 
  mutate(across(matches("count"), list(z = ~ scale(.x))), .keep = "unused")
```

```{r}
}) |>
```

```{r}
fuzzyjoin::fuzzy_join(
    read_csv(nested_here("data", "cps_utilization_events.csv")),
    by = list(
      x = c("event_date", "event_date"),
      y = c("sy_start", "next_sy_start")
      ), match_fun = list(`>=`, `<`)
    ) #|>
  summarise(
    n_events = n(), .by = c(school_match_name, data_schoolyear)
    ) 
  
  
  full_join(
  read_csv(nested_here("data", "cps_utilization_counts.csv")),
  by = c("school_match_name", "data_schoolyear")
  ) |> 
  
  arrange(school_id, data_schoolyear) |>
  mutate(
    n_events       = coalesce(n_events, 0),
    any_events     = as.numeric(n_events > 0),
    n_events_cum   = cumsum(n_events),
    any_events_cum = as.numeric(n_events_cum > 0),
    .by            = school_id
  )

```


```{r}
list(
  "cps_student_crosstabs.csv",
  "cps_utilization_counts.csv"
) |> 
  map(~{
    left_join(
      read_csv(nested_here("data", .x)),
      read_csv(nested_here("data", "cps_name_id_crosswalk.csv")),
      by = "school_match_name"
    ) |> 
      select(-school_match_name)
  }) |> 
  
  # and combine by id
  reduce(
    full_join,
    by = c("school_id", "data_schoolyear")
  ) |> 
  
  # calculate cumulative events reported
  arrange(school_id, data_schoolyear) |> 
  mutate(
    n_events       = coalesce(n_events, 0),
    any_events     = as.numeric(n_events > 0),
    
    n_events_cum   = cumsum(n_events),
    any_events_cum = as.numeric(n_events_cum > 0),
    .by            = school_id
  ) |> 
  
  # calculate time-related variables
  left_join(
    read_csv(nested_here("data", "cps_schoolyear_dates.csv")),
    by = c("data_schoolyear")
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    demog_date = sy_day20,
    data_date  = sy_end
  ) |> 
  select(-any_of(c("sy_start", "sy_end", "next_sy_start", "sy_day20")))
```

```{r}

m_primary <- glmer(

 cbind(attended_days,
       expected_days - attended_days) ~

   factor(year) +
   fractional_exposure +
   years_since_start +

   baseline_att_z +
   poverty_z +
   enrollment_z +
   school_level +

   (1 + time | school),

 family = binomial,
 data = dat
)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
summary(mx <- glmer(
  days_per_school_present ~
    data_schoolyear 
    + poly(impl_frac, 2) 
    + factor(total_impl_years)
    + wave
    + (1 | school_id),
  offset = log(days_per_school_expected),
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data   = schools
  ))
```


```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(lmerTest)
```

```{r}
emmeans::emmeans(
  mx, 
  ~ data_schoolyear 
    + impl_frac
    + total_impl_years
    + wave,
  offset = log(176),
  at = list(impl_frac = c(0.2, 0.5, 1)),
  data = schools
  )
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
summary(mx)

    ))

write_rds(count_mods, nested_here("output", "models", "glm_count_mods.rds"))

asthma_attd_df <- read_csv(nested_here("data", "cps_student_crosstabs.csv")) |> 
  left_join(read_csv(nested_here("data", "cps_name_id_crosswalk.csv"))) |> 
  mutate(
    days_observed = round(days_per_row_present),
    days_expected = round(days_per_row_expected)
  ) |> 
  
  summarise(
    across(
      c(student_count, days_observed, days_expected), 
      ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
    .by = c("school_id", "data_schoolyear", "asthma_status")
    ) |> 
  filter(days_expected > 0) |> 
  arrange(data_schoolyear) |> 
  mutate(year_seq = as.numeric(fct_inorder(data_schoolyear)))

write_rds(asthma_attd_df, nested_here("output", "models", "glm_asthma_attd_df.rds"))

attd_mod <- glmer(
  days_observed ~ data_schoolyear + (year_seq | school_id),
  data   = asthma_attd_df,
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  offset = log(days_expected)
)

write_rds(attd_mod, nested_here("output", "models", "glm_attd_mod.rds"))

asthma_attd_mod <- glmer(
  days_observed ~ data_schoolyear*asthma_status + (year_seq | school_id),
  data   = asthma_attd_df,
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  offset = log(days_expected)
)

write_rds(asthma_attd_mod, nested_here("output", "models", "glm_asthma_attd_mod.rds"))
```

```{r}
map(count_mods, ~{
  
emmeans(
  .x,
  revpairwise ~ data_schoolyear,
  offset  = log(1000),
  type    = "response",
  weights = "cells"
  )
})
```


```{r}
emmeans(
  attd_mod, 
  revpairwise ~ data_schoolyear,
  offset = log(176),
  type = "response",
  weights = "cells"
  )
```

```{r}
emmeans(
  asthma_attd_mod, 
  revpairwise ~ asthma_status | data_schoolyear,
  offset = log(176),
  type = "response",
  weights = "cells"
  )
```

```{r}
emmeans(
  asthma_attd_mod, 
  revpairwise ~ data_schoolyear | asthma_status,
  offset = log(176),
  type = "response",
  weights = "cells"
  )
```

```{r}
emmeans(
  asthma_attd_mod, 
  ~ data_schoolyear | asthma_status,
  offset = log(176),
  type = "response",
  weights = "cells"
  ) |>
  contrast("revpairwise") |> 
  rbind() |>
  update(by = "contrast") |> 
  contrast("revpairwise") |> 
  rbind()
```
